issue.detail: Spec says set start_shifting to 1 forever until reset; contract does not specify whether reset clears start_shifting immediately on the same posedge (R1 same_cycle) or whether S4 is entered only after the completing bit. Alternative: output is registered and becomes 1 one cycle after detecting 1101.
issue.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.
issue.alternative: start_shifting is a registered output that goes high one posedge after the 1101-completing bit is sampled, not on the same row.

issue.detail: Overlapping sequence handling is unspecified: after 1101, does detection restart or can 11011 count again? Contract latches forever so irrelevant until reset, but reset release behavior with partial prefix is unspecified. Alternative: reset returns to S0 only, ignoring data during reset.
issue.spec_evidence: Build a finite-state machine that searches for the sequence 1101 in an input bit stream.
issue.alternative: During reset, data is ignored and state forced to S0; after reset release, matching starts fresh from S0.
